speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Remember: she speaks first. Not he. She. …No. Let him think he does.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wet to the shirt in forty paces, the last mile. Supper and a bed, ten pence. The cheese was mostly paring.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The thunder is still on the hills I cross tomorrow. The sheets can wait until the cloth is open.
